# Spinner (`spinner`)

Busy indicator in three sizes.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSpinner` (types in `dist/web/feedback/spinner.d.ts`): `.mh-spinner`: a busy indicator (`role="status"` with a visually hidden label `__label`).

```ts
export function createSpinner(options: SpinnerOptions = {}):;

export interface SpinnerOptions {
  size?: SpinnerSize;
  /** Read by screen readers (default "Loading"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Takes the current text colour instead of the accent (inside buttons and chips). */
  inherit?: boolean;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSpinner, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const panel = h('div', { 'aria-live': 'polite' }, createSpinner({ size: 'large', label: 'Loading rooms' }).el);

// Swap the spinner for the content once it has loaded.
setTimeout(() => {
  panel.replaceChildren(h('p', {}, 'Living room, Kitchen, Bedroom and Garden are ready.'));
}, 1500);

document.body.append(panel);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Spinner } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SpinnerExample() {
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setLoaded(true), 1500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <div aria-live="polite">
      {loaded ? <p>Living room, Kitchen, Bedroom and Garden are ready.</p> : <Spinner size="large" label="Loading rooms" />}
    </div>
  );
}
```
